thesis: The bear carries the near-term entry objection, while the fundamental bull case remains strong. Because the ADR valuation basis is unresolved and the active decline conflicts with delivered growth, neutral with low confidence is more defensible than either a bargain buy or a broken-business sell.
strongest_counterexample: Comparable revenue and profit growth, high observed margins, substantial positive FCF and modest measured leverage show that the operating franchise remains strong despite the tape.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after an authenticated ADR valuation bridge and five consecutive closes above SMA50, provided the next reported quarter remains FCF-positive.
Reconsider toward sell if the next two reports show year-over-year revenue decline and operating margin below the current observation.
evidence_gaps: Observed price stabilization and independently verified fresh sentiment.
decisive_factors: Price lost 9.28% over five bars on elevated distribution volume.
Strong operating results counter a demand-collapse inference.
